baseline: Final Design Gallery 0.10.1 · Admin Workflow Prototype R4.1

source_of_truth.admin: Standalone Admin Workflow Prototype R4.1 with task-first Place and Review Source intake, ten modules and fifty-five functional views; seven view-specific workspace modes, purpose/start/done guidance, session persistence, evidence, workflow, export and audit simulation use UX-04 visual tokens

shared_contract.unknown_data_rule: Show unknown or unavailable explicitly; never convert missing data to zero, closed or verified.
shared_contract.sponsored_rule: Show Sponsored and Lao advertising text before the decision action; payment does not alter rating or trust.
shared_contract.external_action_rule: Map, Call, Message and Original Source are external handoffs with unavailable/failure fallback.

screens.name: Discovery Feed
screens.primary_outcome: Open a decision-ready Place or an external action from a video-led discovery item.
acceptance: One primary item per mobile viewport
Trust/source is readable without opening Place
Unavailable media is not a dead end
Each action has a separate 44px target

screens.name: Search & Filters
screens.primary_outcome: Find and compare a Place by intent, category, location, price and availability.
acceptance: Query and filters survive view changes and retry
Selected state is programmatically exposed
Empty differs from Error
Sponsored is separated from organic similarity

screens.name: Place Decision
screens.primary_outcome: Decide whether to visit using facts, reviews, category details, freshness and contact actions.
acceptance: Decision facts precede promotional detail
Menu/room/category items include image, name, price and checked date when available
Unavailable action includes a reason
Back returns to prior Search/Feed context

screens.name: Consent & Privacy
screens.primary_outcome: Choose essential-only or optional analytics and change the choice later.
acceptance: Essential-only and analytics choices have equal prominence
Declining analytics does not block core use
Initial focus and dialog structure are accessible
Save failure preserves the choice

screens.name: Executive Overview
screens.primary_outcome: See the operating health of the whole platform from content supply and user decision behavior through partner pipeline, revenue and cash runway.
acceptance: Every KPI shows period and source context
Summary values drill down to underlying records
Revenue excludes interest and unpaid promises
Unauthorized roles only see permitted metrics

screens.name: Operations Queue
screens.primary_outcome: Select the next Place or Trust task by priority, SLA and assignment.
acceptance: P0/P1 and overdue items are not communicated by color alone
Unauthorized state exposes no queue data
Filters remain after refresh
Keyboard order follows queue reading order

screens.name: Place 360 & Editor
screens.primary_outcome: Edit Place data against source evidence and submit a publish-ready version.
acceptance: Field and evidence remain visible together on desktop
Validation summary focuses the first error
Conflict never silently overwrites newer data
Unsaved input is preserved after recoverable failure

screens.name: Trust & Safety Case
screens.primary_outcome: Apply a policy-based decision with evidence, reason code and auditable timeline.
acceptance: Decision requires policy and reason code
Restricted evidence is never exposed to unauthorized roles
Every state change creates an audit event
Appeal reviewer differs from the original decision maker

screens.name: Content & Sources
screens.primary_outcome: Let an operator choose a real-world task—add a Place or add a review-video link—then move the source through rights review, Place matching and publication.
acceptance: The first viewport clearly offers Add Place and Add Review Video
The dependency Place then Source then Rights then Publish is visible
A source cannot be created without a linked Place
Every item retains an original URL
Creating a Place opens the Place Draft
Publication is blocked when mandatory evidence is missing

screens.name: Partner Management
screens.primary_outcome: Manage a business from qualified lead through paid pilot, active partnership, performance review and renewal.
acceptance: Pipeline value distinguishes forecast from paid revenue
Paid pilot status requires payment evidence
Partner benefits cannot alter review score
Every relationship has an owner and next activity

screens.name: Sponsored Campaigns
screens.primary_outcome: Plan, approve, deliver and measure Sponsored Campaigns while preserving editorial and review integrity.
acceptance: Sponsored label is mandatory and adjacent to placement
Payment cannot change rating, ranking evidence or trust score
Campaign outcome is reported separately from organic performance
Campaign revenue requires verified payment

screens.name: Platform Analytics
screens.primary_outcome: Measure discovery, search success, Decision Intent, map/contact actions and Place contribution using privacy-safe aggregates.
acceptance: Metric definitions are visible
Filters apply consistently to all widgets
Charts link to permitted underlying records
Small segments are protected from re-identification

screens.name: Revenue & Finance
screens.primary_outcome: Control verified revenue, recurring income, expense, founder living cost, budget gates and cash runway.
acceptance: Interest and verbal intent are never counted as revenue
Every actual amount links to evidence
Experiment ceiling and founder living cost are separate
Next budget tranche is not released before its gate passes

screens.name: System & Access
screens.primary_outcome: Control user roles, record access, integrations, feature releases, system health and privileged audit events.
acceptance: Least-privilege access is the default
Permission changes require owner approval and audit
Feature flags expose rollout scope
System health distinguishes degraded from unavailable
